The main takeaway from our work is that

a wide variety of passive mixers with different properties can be realized by varying the number of phases in the mixer, and that this number of phases can be optimized for a given set of specifications.
the design of such mixers is a trade-off between the number of mixer phases, LO power consumption, noise figure and out-of-band lineartiy.
the performance of such mixers is largely independent of the number of phases, and can be described using only a small number of parameters.
